    The indicator family on a graded algebra Λ ≅ kP #

    For Θ : kP ≅ Λ carrying ray vectors to homogeneous elements (degree deg ℓ(r) and weight ℓ(r)): transported supported cochains satisfying the equalities of Proposition 11.2 are cocycles; they are normalized relative to the transported identities; an indicator of a class of character χ has character χ and internal degree deg χ; and the family m + Σ t_E μ_E is associative (Proposition 11.3(1)). These are the hypotheses of Theorem 7.7 other than spanning (binary-families.tex).
